title: Theme
description: Theme definition, as listed in the items of themes and theme groups. A theme corresponds to a QGIS project published as WMS by QGIS Server.

labelProfiles.description: Labelling profiles of the Redlining plugin, keyed by layer name.

title.description: Profile title, defaults to the name.

expression.description: Label expression, in QGIS expression syntax.

printGrid.description: Scale dependent grid intervals for printing, in descending order by scale denominator: an entry applies to the scales between its own and the next entry's scale denominator.

id.description: Theme identifier, used in the t URL parameter of the viewer. Generated if not specified.

url.description: URL of the WMS served by QGIS Server. With qwc-docker, /ows/<path> where <path> is the path of the QGIS project below qgs-resources, without extension.

title.description: Theme title, overrides the WMS title.

description.description: Additional description, shown below the theme title.

thumbnail.description: Image file in assets/img/mapthumbs. If omitted, <project_basename>.png is used if it exists, otherwise the thumbnail is generated with a WMS GetMap.

default.description: Use this theme as default theme.

disabled.description: Skip this theme when generating the themes configuration.

wmsOnly.description: Only configure the entry as a WMS, not as a theme.

hidden_in_ows_landing_page.description: Hide the service from the OGC service landing page.

wmsBasicAuth.description: HTTP basic authentication credentials for QGIS Server, only used when generating the themes configuration with the qwc2 scripts and not stored in themes.json.

mapCrs.description: Map projection as EPSG code, defaults to the project projection. The projection must be defined in config.json.

defaultDisplayCrs.description: Default CRS for the coordinates in the bottom bar and in measurements, defaults to mapCrs.

additionalMouseCrs.description: Additional projections for displaying the mouse position, as EPSG codes. WGS84 and mapCrs are available by default, other projections must be defined in config.json.

extent.description: Initial extent as [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in mapCrs, overrides the extent advertised by the WMS.

mapExtent.description: Full allowed extent of the map as [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in mapCrs.

scales.description: Allowed map scale denominators, defaults to defaultScales.

format.description: Image format of the WMS GetMap requests.

attribution.description: Attribution shown in the bottom right corner of the map.

backgroundLayers.description: Available background layers, defaults to defaultBackgroundLayers.

externalLayers.description: External layers replacing internal layers of the project.

internalLayer.description: Name of the project layer to replace.

name.description: Name of the matching external layer definition in themes.externalLayers.

minSearchScaleDenom.description: Minimum scale denominator when zooming to search results, overrides the value of config.json.

predefinedFilters.description: Predefined filters of the MapFilter plugin.

filter.description: Fixed filter applied to the theme.

layerfilter.description: Filter expression per layer name, in the format of the MapFilter plugin.

mapTips.description: Whether map tips are enabled by default. If null or not set, defaultMapTips applies.

skipEmptyFeatureAttributes.description: Skip empty attributes in the identify results.

collapseLayerGroupsBelowLevel.description: Layer tree level below which groups are initially collapsed. By default the tree is completely expanded.

layerTreeHiddenSublayers.description: Sublayers omitted from the layer tree, but still displayed in the map.

lockedVisibilityPreset.description: Visibility preset (QGIS map theme) whose layer styles are locked.

visibilityPresetsBlacklist.description: Visibility presets (QGIS map themes) to exclude, * matching any characters.

flags.description: Arbitrary flags, used to show or hide menu items, toolbar items and map buttons.

startupView.description: View mode in which the theme is initially displayed.

dataset.description: Dataset configured in the obliqueImagery service.

default.description: Display this dataset by default, otherwise the first one is used.

backgroundLayer.description: Name of the background layer displayed with the dataset.

backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of the background layer, from 0 (transparent) to 255 (opaque).

title.description: Title in the dataset switcher, defaults to the dataset.

titleMsgId.description: Translation message ID of the title, alternative to title.

printScales.description: Allowed print scale denominators, defaults to defaultPrintScales.

printResolutions.description: Available print resolutions in DPI, defaults to defaultPrintResolutions. If empty, the resolution can be freely chosen.

defaultPrintLayout.description: Name of the print layout selected by default.

extraPrintTemplates.description: Paths of additional print templates added to the theme, relative to the print layouts directory.

printLabelBlacklist.description: IDs of the print layout labels not exposed in the print dialog.

printLabelConfig.description: Input configuration of the print layout labels, keyed by label ID.

additionalProperties.description: Label input configuration, with any additional textarea property, e.g. maxLength, rows or placeholder.

options.description: Options of a combo box, displayed instead of a text field.

printLabelForAttribution.description: ID of the print layout label receiving the current attribution when printing.

printLabelForSearchResult.description: ID of the print layout label receiving the current search result when printing.

extraPrintLayers.description: Additional layers marked as internal print layers, omitted from the layer tree.

extraPrintParameters.description: Additional query parameters of the GetPrint requests, as KEY=VALUE&KEY2=VALUE2 (QGIS Server 3.32 or later).

extraLegendParameters.description: Additional query parameters of the GetLegendGraphic requests, as KEY=VALUE&KEY2=VALUE2.

printUrl.description: Base URL of the GetPrint requests, only used by the qwc2 scripts.

legendUrl.description: Base URL of the GetLegendGraphic requests, only used by the qwc2 scripts.

featureInfoUrl.description: Base URL of the GetFeatureInfo requests, only used by the qwc2 scripts.

watermark.description: Watermark added to raster export images, each entry being passed as WATERMARK_<KEY> parameter of the export request.

texpadding.description: Padding between the text and the frame, in points.

name.description: Name of the sublayer providing the snapping geometries.

min.description: Minimum scale denominator at which snapping is active.

max.description: Maximum scale denominator at which snapping is active.

featureCount.description: Maximum number of snapping geometries retrieved for the current map extent.

wfsMaxScale.description: Scale denominator below which loaded WFS layers are used for snapping.

featureReport.description: Feature report templates of the document service, keyed by sublayer name.

single_report.description: Compile one report for all features instead of one report per feature.

format.description: Report format, e.g. pdf, html, csv, docx, ods, odt, pptx, rtf, xlsx or xml.

themeInfoLinks.description: Links shown as a menu next to the theme in the theme switcher.

titleMsgId.description: Translation message ID of the menu title, alternative to title.

entries.description: Names of the matching link definitions in themes.themeInfoLinks.

pluginData.description: Data passed to custom plugins: names of the matching plugin data resources in themes.pluginData, keyed by plugin name.

editConfig.description: Editing configuration, keyed by layer name, or the path of a file containing it. Usually generated by the config generator.

config.description: Viewer configuration overriding the global entries of config.json for this theme, including desktop, mobile and plugins entries.
